subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to
stimulus: rewrite the whole story. 1×8=8 (a) One day he became very hungry and could not get anything to eat. (b) The food was very hot. (c) He came to a house and asked an old woman to give him something to eat. (d) As a result he burnt his fingers. (e) He hurriedly dug his fingers right at the middle of the dish. (f) Then he disguised himself as a poor traveller and supported himself by begging. (g) One young Taimur attacked a province of a powerful prince but unfortunately his soldiers were all killed. (h) The old woman fell pity for him and quickly gave Taimur a full dish of food. R Section B : Writing Test (Marks 50)
guide_solution: Reordering sentences (g) + (f) + (a) + (c) + (h) + (e) + (b) + (d). Section B : Writing Test
